proposals: DPIIT should publish the state and district-wise FDI equity tables for January–March 2020 and April–June 2020, the two lockdown quarters for which no standalone Table No.16 could be found, so that the district series from October 2019 has no hole in it.

DPIIT should release the full state and district-wise FDI series as a downloadable CSV file updated each quarter, so that users do not have to parse PDFs with split state names, page breaks and watermarks to reconstruct 3,320 rows of the government’s own data.

DPIIT should add the state and district where the investment is deployed, alongside the recipient company’s registered office, to its collection of FDI inflow data, so that four registered-office districts holding 72.6% of inflows can be distinguished from where factories and other assets are actually built.

DPIIT and the Reserve Bank of India should publish a state-wise breakdown of total FDI, including reinvested earnings and other capital, not only equity inflows, so that the regional picture covers the larger, differently distributed total this piece could not break down.
